decisions.reason: Because the service has remained in the portfolio beyond launch and fits the firm's support-intensive core offer, management would likely see no clear performance shortfall versus aspirations and keep it, though it could still be reabsorbed if demand proves thin.

As a newly launched module with good strategic fit but only limited website prominence so far, it is still in the trial-and-learning phase and the firm's slack and installed base make continued testing more likely than withdrawal.

A secure healthcare messaging service is closely aligned with regulatory digital workflows and was prominently presented, so absent evidence of underperformance management would likely judge it above aspiration or strategically necessary and retain it.
